GAB.note: Document names no national digital strategy beyond a statement of the head of state's orientation.
A convention with ANINF for digitalising municipal services is signed, but no system run or built by ANINF is stated.

facts.fact: The communes of Akanda and Owendo are connected by optical fibre to the government's Réseau de l'administration gabonaise, among initiatives launched there, per Gabonclic.info.
Two communes, Akanda and Owendo, are named as linked to the RAG by fibre, per Gabonclic.info.
